input_ref: jump | Pharmacy advocate: When can I offer 90-day mail order for a maintenance drug?

output.reason: None of the approved units states when 90-day mail order can be offered for a maintenance drug. U-RX-EDU-001-13 only covers the specialty-drug exclusion.
